name: OmniMedVQA
intro: OmniMedVQA 是由 73 个真实医学图像分类数据集构建的大规模医学视觉问答基准，含 118,010 张不同图像与 127,995 条问答，覆盖 12 种成像模态、20 多个解剖区域和五类问题；发布时仅 42 个开放源随包提供图像，另 31 个受限源提供问答与相对路径。
org: University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Southeast University
build_method: 73个医学分类数据集模板化、按模板反比例平衡采样、ChatGPT-3.5语义保持改写与2至4选项干扰项生成、人工双重检查；按42个开放源和31个受限源分层发布
metric: Question-answering accuracy, Prefix-based accuracy；分别按五类问题、总体与模态报告，论文另给仅开放数据子集结果
openness: partly public, mixed access and source-specific licenses
eval_feature: 问答生成分数与前缀似然分数双轨评测, 五类医学能力与模态分析
scale: 论文全量：118,010张不同图像、127,995条问答、73个源数据集、12种模态、20+解剖区域、5类问题；发布：42个开放源含图像，31个受限源仅含问答/相对路径
openness_en: Partly public, mixed access and source-specific licenses
build_method_en: Template conversion of 73 medical classification datasets, inverse-proportional sampling by template, ChatGPT-3.5 meaning-preserving rewriting and two-to-four-option distractor generation, human double checking, and tiered release across 42 open and 31 restricted sources
eval_feature_en: Dual Question-answering and Prefix-likelihood Scores, Five Medical Capabilities and Modality Analysis
intro_en: OmniMedVQA is a large-scale medical VQA benchmark built from 73 authentic medical image-classification datasets, with 118,010 distinct images and 127,995 QA items across 12 imaging modalities, more than 20 anatomical regions, and five question types; the release bundles images for only 42 open sources, while 31 restricted sources provide QA and relative paths.

drawio_review_note: source_stage=paper-alignment; reviewed_at=2026-07-22; benchmark=OmniMedVQA. Primary paper evidence is arXiv:2402.09181v2 at https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.09181v2 and https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.09181v2; the downloaded PDF SHA-256 is 5704bd6b4f4dee51862b8fdcc0ba56ca393694ef4023b72307a6fd77008850d7. The paper-v2 construction starts from 73 medical classification datasets containing authentic medical images across 12 imaging modalities and more than 20 anatomical regions. Dataset-specific QA templates convert original categories and add modality/anatomy questions. The number of potential images is calculated per template, then inverse-proportional sampling assigns a smaller sampling ratio to templates with more images to balance categories and reduce repetitive QA bias. All QA items fall into five types: Modality Recognition, Anatomy Identification, Disease Diagnosis, Lesion Grading, and Other Biological Attributes. Paper Table 3 reports 19,381/19,427 image/item incidences for modality, 19,992/20,330 for anatomy, 73,099/73,455 for disease, 2,621/2,621 for lesion grading, and 12,156/12,162 for other attributes. The image incidences are not additive because one image can support multiple question types; the paper total is 118,010 distinct images and 127,995 QA items. ChatGPT-3.5 reformulates each question to vary expression and syntax while preserving the answer, and generates incorrect candidates. Each item has two to four choices: two-option items are commonly yes/no, and three-option items often concern lesion grading. Human double checking is a distinct final quality-control step. Paper-v2 evaluation is zero-shot over eight general-domain and four medical-specialized LVLMs. Question-answering Score sends image, question and options to the model, takes a free-form response, maps it to the most similar candidate, then compares that candidate with ground truth. Prefix-based Score prefixes visual features to text embeddings, computes a likelihood for every question-option pair, chooses the highest-likelihood option, and compares it with ground truth. The two accuracies are reported separately by five question types, overall, and modality; paper Tables 11-13 separately report the completely open-access subset and must not be conflated with the full benchmark tables. The release boundary is paper-backed: 42 source datasets are completely open, so their images and constructed QA are provided; 31 datasets are restricted access, so only QA items and association instructions/relative paths are provided, and users must reacquire the original images under each source license. Consequently, 73 sources and 118,010 images describe the full benchmark contract, not a claim that all image bytes are freely redistributable in one globally licensed package. Official code is fixed to OpenGVLab/Multi-Modality-Arena commit bd2999a3be2bf4539a7e071cf2cfab5822f66417. The repository README SHA-256 is 01845e0817e83941cbed760634d62ed93567b67aecbdbba8be6795db7868c1d2, MedicalEval/README.md is 2fdc2e29e9c928e4dd14588740d037c8122defc86a8d04642a9a4776005bfeb9, Question-answering_Score/utils/medicalqa.py is 9adc1aa85068ac182a1e2b0b320bb7577ea9a701de06ea3d59bdfe38ec80efe0, and Prefix_based_Score/medical_blip2.py is e1ec2be84e86a6c2d47e6317ac4380128abf71617ef00d876549180756607e3e. Released code is model-specific rather than a fully packaged benchmark runner. README instructions require local dataset paths and model weights; the question-answering scorer uses difflib SequenceMatcher to select the closest option and computes successes over produced predictions. Its broad inference exception handler can skip rows before scoring, so the released implementation boundary is explicit instead of silently treating code execution as identical to every paper table. The official Hugging Face dataset is foreverbeliever/OmniMedVQA revision 1ba51c28fc0773bdf7efb8396e5bcfd4227e22da, last modified 2024-04-30, public and ungated. The dataset card SHA-256 is f6ab4c363298083f34a22415ebf8cc9d9c8c8ad099a84c2abc391206d884d347. It exposes one OmniMedVQA.zip payload of 10,698,178,715 bytes whose linked SHA-256 is 12245e0f99afbc7d6f70e4ca3c2e5a7979a01816cd8159ae34539f4aa76adee0, plus README and .gitattributes. The 10.7 GB ZIP was not downloaded or independently recounted in this source-stage audit. The fixed card says Images contains only open-access-source images while QA_information contains both Open-access and Restricted-access JSON, with relative paths for restricted images. The page therefore preserves paper scale but labels the payload count as paper/card-derived rather than locally materialized evidence. Openness is intentionally changed from public to partly public, mixed access and source-specific licenses. The HF card contains no global license identifier, tells users to follow the original datasets licenses and terms, and assigns image intellectual property to the original rights holders. The fixed Git snapshot has no root LICENSE file. Public/ungated hosting therefore does not erase source-level restrictions. The English source contains no Han characters, the Chinese source preserves equivalent semantics and identical positioned topology, every secondary evidence/access edge is explicitly dashed, and Mermaid fallbacks are regenerated exactly from the source specs. Formal .drawio, .arch.json, .svg, and .png assets were intentionally not modified in this source-stage pass. Formal publication evidence [site-a12a-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3304×785 (English) and 3285×785 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3302×783 and 3283×783. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
